balls.text: top shot to end the innings! Teja walks down and hits it straight and hard
walks across to try and hit it over fine leg but PK bowls it wide and Teja adjusts well, opening the face to turn the ball down to third man for two
peach of a yorker from PK, the blow had no effect on him clearly

down leg stump, he connects well off his pads past short fine leg, finding the gap. Kumble slides and picks but cannot stop the three ... Uthappa collects the throw and lobs it back toward the bowler, who doesn't see it coming and cops it flush on the head .. ouch
swing and a miss from Edwards, playing across the line to a full one
a low full toss that Teja swings behind square leg

slower ball, leg cutter down the pads, Teja shuffles and plays it away toward square leg, there's some hesitation as he turns back for the second and his partner cannot get back in time as a good flat throw comes back ... got to feel for Rao there, sold down the river because Teja urged him on but then stopped in his tracks
this one's on a length and Rao hits it down past mid-on
another slow short ball, Rao turns around in his crease as he swings and misses, thats a good way to slip in a short ball
banged in outside off stump, Rao has a flirt and misses out

ah, a cheeky attempt to go across the sticks ends his fine innings! Rohit walks right across to well outside off stump but the ball is not as straight as he would have liked, then he closes the face early and pops up an easy catch that KP, running in from mid-on, takes near the nonstriker's stumps ... but take a bow, son, that is a fine innings to boost Deccan
pitches on a length, he clears the leg and goes over extra cover
skips down, KP sees him and fires it in, Kohli dives in the deep
slower ball, works it past midwicket and raises a super half-century
six more! Another pick-up shot, just clearing the leg and heaving it flat over midwicket for his fifth six, what a time he's having in the IPL
again he skips down, swings wildly, and is lucky as the ball drops in no mans' land in front of wide long-on
slower ball, Rao dances down and biffs it down to long-on
flat down the stumps, Rao charges and inside-edges to square leg
pitched up outside off, Rao chips it in the air through extra cover
yorker outside off stump, beats Rao's bat as he tries to dab it fine
full and wide, he makes room and slashes down to third man
thats an old fashioned heave across the line from Rohit, just clearing the front leg and swinging, its well connected and he gets six over midwicket, his fourth
serves up a full toss on the pads, Rao clips it to midwicket
full on off stump, Rao drives it straight to cover ... crucial dot ball
fuller outside off stump, he shuffles and works the ball to leg
slower ball, tossed up wide, Rao comes onto the front foot, opens the faces, and steers the ball behind square toward backward point
short and wide, he cuts with an under edge and scampers one
caught PK, bowled KP! Another big swing across the line but he's gotten underneath this one a bit too much, its very high and finds an animated Praveen out at wide long-on
thats big! Styris swings superbly and deposits that rows over midwicket
tossed up on the stumps, Styris heaves an inside edge past midwicket
slower ball, Rohit picks it and eases a pleasing drive through cover
bit of room, Styris cuts toward backward point and sets off, Kohli swoops in, collects, has a shy but misses ... a direct hit would have had his man
leans forward and drives into the gap at extra cover, running hard
too wide so he taps it into the off side for a single
pitches it up outside off stump, Rohit drives straight to extra cover

ah what a silly drop in the deep! PK drops short, Styris pulls loosely over midwicket, where the ball is taken by Karan Sharma on the move in front of the boundary but then he juggles it .. once .. twice ... and out of his grasp, oh dear
slower ball down the pads, Rohit shuffles and works it into the gap at square leg, the sweeper is deep and slow to react so Rohit hustles Styris and KP doesn't approve
short and wide, turns away, Rohit cuts and misses
tossed up on leg stump and Styris turns it wide of midwicket
short and wide and cut between cover and point for one more
flat down the pads and worked away toward Kumble for a single
well taken there! KP tosses it up wide, Gilchrist drives hard and flat but Virat Kohli intercepts it at short extra cover with a lovely leaping catch high to his left
down he skips, the ball slides down the pads, and he turns it fine
fuller and flatter and worked off the pads for a single now
short outside off stump and Rohit picks it up from where it pitches, smacked over midwicket for six, really a top shot because that was a quick delivery
lovely use of the feet from Rohit, dancing down to meet the ball on the volley and he swings it miles over midwicket for six more, an expensive over continues
expectedly this is shorter and flatter, Rohit punches into the covers
top shot for six! Kumble flights it down leg stump, Rohit kneels down and sweeps hard and flat, there are calls for the catch but a desperate effort on the ropes wont do
pitches outside leg stump, spins away, Gilchrist gets down to heave it away but misses, again struck safely outside the line of impact and a tidy end to the KP over
spins down Rohit's pads, he shuffles and brushes it fine
flat on leg stump, clipped around the corner for a single
swings it down leg stump and picks the gap at deep square leg
slower ball, still flat though, Rohit walks forward and tries to clip to leg but misses, struck well outside the line of impact so you cannot give those out, an inside edge perhaps too
full and flat on off stump, Gilchrist patiently drives it down to mid-off
flatter, spinning away very wide but he reaches out and steals one
much slower ball, Gilchrist advances and drives back to Kumble, who fumbles
yowza! Down he skips, collecting on the full, clipping the wrists for six

ah another chance but no one's there! Kumble flights it up on middle and leg, Rohit drives on down the ground but ends up spooning it in the wrong direction and lucky for him it lands safely between mid-off and long-off
goes on off the track, Gilchrist waits and dabs it to backward point
low dipping ball on leg stump and easily on-driven down the ground
slower ball on leg stump and driven back to the bowler
pitches it up wide, Gilchrist has a go but cannot beat backward point

oh he's smacked the pants off that one! Again just picks the length easily and swings the ball over midwicket for six more ... what a treat to watch this man ... I bet Australia could use him in Dubai right now!
slower ball on a length just outside off stump, Rohit is early into the shot and plays it in the air but safely wide of mid-off for a single
good comeback, full on leg stump and on-driven for a single
going, going and gone for his half-century! Pure timing and hand-eye coordination from Gilchrist, picking the length and swinging it over deep square leg for six
quicker and flatter on the pads and turned around the corner into the gap between fine leg and square leg and urges Gilchrist to run hard for the second run
another slider on around leg stump, he plays for turn but misses
streaky! Gilchrist charges Kumble, who slips in the slider, it goes across Gilchrist and he nearly edges it to short third man but survives in the end
flat on middle and leg, turns in, Gilchrist on-drives to midwicket
shorter, flatter, Rohit gets back and punches it in the air past Kumble
tossed up on leg stump, turns away, Gilchrist works it square
pitched up outside off and Rohit ... drum roll ... shoulder arms
slow bouncer down the leg stump, Rohit ducks, wide called
straighter ball and he turns it straight to midwicket
pitched up outside off stump and Sharma defends to cover
oh so close! Ryder looks on in agony, Sharma looks back in thanks as his loose attempt at a forward drive results in an inside edge that beats leg stump for four
pitches just outside leg, Gilchrist shuffles and clips it fine for one

and he strikes first ball, what a guy! Pitches it up and Laxman drives on the rise but he doesn't get all the elevation needed and picks out a tumbling Steyn running in from long-off, diving forward and then holding the ball as he trips
full and flat and Gilchrist drives to a diving cover fielder
a touch flatter, shorter and quicker outside off stump and Laxman slices it into teh off side where Kohli chases it
slower ball, tossed up on a length, Gilchrist pushes to the off
flat down leg stump, Laxman makes room to swipe and loses balance
tossed up on a length, Laxman makes room and drives on the rise to cover where Ryder is alert
flighted up outside leg, turned for one toward short fine leg
low full toss but he just gets a single down to long-off
makes room and plays an ugly heave, inside-edging down leg
full and wide, he kneels down and hits it very hard but doesn't get the desired placement so the result is a single to extra cover
oh thats been hit, eh? Another fullish ball to Gilchrist's liking and he tonks it back very hard between the umpire and Laxman for four
he goes straight, he goes hard, he goes six! Slower ball pitched up and Gilchrist connects very well, hitting it right back over the sight screen for six more
slower ball, pitched up, Gilchrist pushes uppishly to cover
pitches just outside off stump, Laxman gets back and plays a stylish shot off the back foot but picks out backward point
slower ball, 118ks, opens the face and gets one to third man
short and wide, Gilchrist has a slash but cannot connect
oh so close! Laxman is rooted to his crease as he tries to turn the ball of his stumps but gets a leading edge that just evades a leaping backward point
good stuff, tidy delivery on off stump and Laxman defends it back
pitched up on a length outside off, gentle away swing, no footwork from Laxman as he goes fishing and fails to connect
gets off the mark first ball, steering the ball down to third man

he's given him! PK pitches it full on middle and leg stump, Gibbs is late on the attempted flick across the line and umpire Sahiba raises his finger in a flash ... replays show the ball was hitting leg stump
nice little shot that! Gibbs gets across his stumps and looks to paddle the full ball around the corner, ends up with a top edge but its still over the ropes at fine leg
low full toss outside off stump is punched to a sliding Kumble at mid-off, there's some sprightly work from the old man, good to see
swings down the stumps, another big swing and a miss, the ball brushes his pads and Uthappa - not a regular wicketkeeper - cannot cut if off so thats four more
well bowled slower ball, 115ks, pitches it up and Gilchrist checks his shot, he wanted to turn it away but the length did it for him and he turned it uppishly to mid-on
pitches full outside leg stump, gets some swing, Gilchrist has a big swing and misses, the ball goes rolling into the off side ... the umpire didn't think any bat so its a leg bye .. seems correct
dragged in short again and this one is pulled out to the sweeper
down the track he comes, swinging at it, ball beats bat by a whisker, Uthappa collects and Kallis seems to be interested .. no reaction from the umpire and rightly so
pitches just outside leg stump, short, Gilchrist pulls but cannot connect and the ball dribbles of his pads towards point
too short and pulled powerfully out to the sweeper at deep square
Gibbs walks down the track, collects on the full, and beats extra cover
sweetness! Pitched up in the slot and Gilchrist just drives it ever so cleanly down the ground for half a dozen ... what a treat this man is, even after retirement
pitched up very wide, Gilchrist needn't have played at it but does and inside-edges behind the stumps
short and wide and slapped over backward point for four

banged in short on the stumps, Gilchrist gets into shape to try and hook but cannot get bat on it, the ball hits his thigh and pops up, he then tries to kick it away from the stumps but he's safe anyway
man oh man! Short and wide and Gilchrist has a free swing, slapping the ball over gully and third man cannot cut that baby off .... he's hitting them well so far
pitched up and immediately Steyn gets some swing, Gibbs comes tentatively onto the front foot and tries to twirl the bat out of the way to leave but it clips it and runs past gully
pitches on a length and again Gilchrist watchfully pushes to cover
slower ball, 111ks, pitched up and Gilchrist defends it back
a wee bit of room outside off stump and dang, those are some strong wrists! Gilchrist transfers the weight, gets over the ball, and dispatches it behind square
bad bowling this, short and wide and crunched through the covers
dragged in short and thats pulled from outside off with power
gets some room and has a go but cannot pierce cover or point
makes room and slashes the drive out to deep cover sweeper
pitched up and PK hits it in the air wide of mid-off for a single
takes a few steps and ends up giving Gibbs an easy catch at long-on

hah, he's hurt RP! Pitched up full, PK gets up on one leg and plays a Dhoni shot, flat and rocketed back to the bowler, who drives to stop it and ends up wincing in pain ... his reaction cannot be published on this site, sorry
full again, no room to work with, driven to long-off to raise his fifty
superb slower ball, full in the slot and Kohli just pats it back to RP
short of a length and he swings and misses
what a shot! PK is just swinging for free and gets his second six, no footwork but he connects to the slower off cutter really well, hitting it over long-off
too straight and Kohli works it off the pads for a single
full on the toes, flicked out to the deep, where Rao slides across to stop but his back foot touched the ropes so thats four more to Kohli
banged in short outside off, Kohli looks for the uppercut but no bat on ball, Gilchrist collects and then looks up as the umpire signals wide
slower ball, short of a length outside off stump, Kohli backs away and cannot connect and then admonishes himself
on the pads and he gets onto the toes, clipping it past square leg
on a length, in the slot to be hit and PK hammers it over mid-off for six
nearly a yorker just outside off stump and PK keeps it out
good catch from the old man! Karan again makes room and reaches out to bottom-edge a very wide delivery, Gilchrist flings himself to his left and pouches it low
banged in short, Karan backs away and swipes, cannot connect
slower ball served up full and he clips an on-drive for a single
short and wide and slashed through cover and point for one
full on the pads, clipped out to the deep midwicket sweeper
slower ball goes astray down the pads for another Harmeet wide
flashes hard again and gets a thick edge over short third man
pitched up and Kohli goes over the covers out to the sweeper

slower ball, a touch shorter, Bishnoi slashes and gets the toe end of the bat on ball, it rolls down in front of Gilchrist, who collects and throws it down the other end to get Bishnoi ... he was called on by Kohli but didn't react
slower ball outside off stump, he slashes it off the edge past gully
low full toss outside off stump, watchfully pushed to cover for one
full on the pads and flicked down to the fine leg sweeper
hard shot over extra cover, got up on the toes and swung away
gone! Dravid gives Styris the charge, who holds back the length, Dravid slaps the ball in the air but picks out a running fielder down at a sort of wide long-off
overpitched outside off stump, driven down toward extra cover
short outside off stump, persisting with the slower ball, Kohli picks the length and pulls hard through midwicket and beats two men in the deep, excellent placement
starts off with a slower ball, Dravid mistimes the shot past Styris' left
bouncer over the stumps, Dravid ducks, wide not called
full and swinging in, Kohli plays a classy clip out to the same sweeper
banged in short, he goes for the pull, its not timed too well but lands in front of a tumbling square leg patroller and he cannot cut it off
low full toss on the pads, clipped superbly past a diving fine leg fielder
good yorker on the stumps, Kohli backed away and just managed to jam the bat down in time else he was heading back inside for a cool Kingfisher lager
short and wide, Dravid makes room and cuts through cover-point
ugly heave across the stumps, inside-edging to midwicket, runs hard
slower ball beats Dravid's loose one-handed slash, low bounce too
full on the stumps, Dravid exposes all three and beats mid-on
short of a length and now he pulls it down through midwicket
slower ball, wider on a length outside off stump, Dravid makes room and cuts off the toe end of the bat, edging wide of Gilchrist for four down to third man
good shot for six! Straight back over the sightscreen ... just clear the leg and give it a bit of humpty ... good simple tactic from Dravid
flatter on off stump, Dravid uses his feet and drives past midwicket
uses his feet and drives on the rise toward extra cover
drops this one short, he rocks back and pulls past midwicket
slides down the pads, Dravid sweeps out to the sweeper for one
reaches out and drives this one into the covers
flat, wide, stays low, cut hard but straight to the man at point
lovely swing off the pads, flat over square leg for six and Dravid can take back the orange cap because he is again the highest run scorer in the IPL
backs away and has a big swish but cannot connect
slower ball, pretty wide, he reaches out and slaps it past point
a touch shorter and he pulls off one leg, finding the gap at midwicket
a tad fuller, bit of swing, driven back to Harmeet's left side
back of a length outside off stump and a text book back-foot defence
too wide down the pads
slows the pace, Dravid turns it from middle and leg past square
flatter on the stumps, he goes back and works it to midwicket
tossed up outside off stump and thats played to cover
clever bowling, daft shot, simple stumping! Ojha tosses it up unabashedly, lures KP out of his crease, playing across his stumps, he misses all ends up and Gilchrist  mops up
now short and wide and Dravid slaps it out to deep cover sweeper
swept on length and swept hard in front of square, excellent shot
waits for the ball and slaps it hard past Gibbs at backward point
slower ball outside off stump, Dravid wafts and misses out
opens the face and steers the ball straight to backward point

pitched up again, Dravid gets forward and hits it back over Styris' head, calling immediately for two, KP harries back and dives back and is just saved as Styris collects and breaks the stumps... a direct hit from the deep would have made that interesting
well fielded at short cover, Dravid walked right down the track and hit the ball uppishly but Rohit dived across to save runs
good shot from Dravid given that mid-off is up, just clears the front leg and hammers the ball down the ground, thats one bounce and four
gets outside the line again and is safe as he misses out on the sweep
good bowling, Ojha changes his pace, flattens it on leg stump, Dravid plays out in front of his pads and works the ball just wide of midwicket for another single
reaches out and swipes at one just outside off stump, struck outside the line, Ojha appeals but no response from the umpire, gets Dravid back on strike
full and flat down the pads and he paddles it around the corner
another few dozen of those may do some good! Dravid chases this one inside-out over the covers for four, placement was superb there
well bowled, spins away from middle stump and KP defends
another firm square drive into the gap but only for a single
pitched up and he drives hard but straight to the covers
sees room and slashes hard behind backward point for one
gets across and whips the slower ball off his stumps in style
bounces him over the head and a wide is duly called

great catch out at deep midwicket! Another firm shot from Uthappa, picking the length and pulling it flat over the infield but its that man Ravi Teja who sprints across and dives to his left to hold a beauty ... really good catch, he had ground to cover and was chasing a hard ball
superb fielding saves four! That was a half-volley on the pads, clipped well too, but Gibbs dives at midwicket rather athletically
dot ball to end the over, tossed up and KP defends it back
reaches across and sweeps it down to fine leg, excellent placement
quicker ball, straighter too, and he clips it wide of midwicket for two
well bowled again, just drawing a forward defensive from KP
tossed up on a teasing length and KP pats it back
flat on off stump, Uthappa shuffles and clips it for a single
back of a length and slanting across, he dabs it to third man for one
clever short ball to someone who doesn't play the short ball well at all, Uthappa remains committed to the front foot and pulls his head out of the way
finally he connects! Another firm slap and its drilled past mid-off
pitched up full and he swipes an ugly shot to midwicket
tidy length just outside off and KP punches a single to extra cover
drives off the front foot but straight back to RP, another dot ball there
good ball, full on off stump and played back to the bowler
sprays it down the leg stump for a wide
reaches out and drives with a thick outside edge safe of gully
good bowling from the young sardar, keeps it up on off stump to get Uthappa watchfully defending to the off side, he runs hard and gets a single
pitches on middle and leg, Uthappa flicks it off the pads
walks across the stumps, clips it off the stumps for a single
KP walks across, Harmeet aims for leg stump but its too wide
starts off on the dime and Uthappa shuffles to turn it to midwicket
pitched up again, he drives with too much bottom hand, RP fields
got him at cover! Pitched up wide to be hit but Kallis, as he has so often in his international career, slaps the half-volley straight to Rohit on the off side, who takes it easily
much, much fuller and Kallis squeezes an inside edge onto boot
commits Kallis on the front foot, he drives it straight to cover
walks down the track and pulls the short ball flat over midwicket
pitches on leg stump, Kallis clips it straight to midwicket
gets room and slashes over gully on the bounce to third man
nips back in sharply off the seam, Kallis defends and takes the ball in the midriff, good stuff from a heated Edwards ... he was stellar in the first match too
back of a length on off stump, goes back and turns it to midwicket
no footwork this time again, just flashes at one swinging away from off
swings hard at a full one just outside off, connecting with warm air
short and wide, Uthappa chases with a loose drive but the ball drops in front of Ojha in the covers
much fuller, off stump, hint of swing, squirted toward midwicket
back of a length outside leg stump, sits up, Uthappa's feet don't go anywhere as he pushes at it
comes onto the front foot to gently push the ball to cover, sets off
back of a length on off stump, stays low, Kallis pushes from the crease
back of a length, pitches just outside leg stump and seams across to nearly cut Kallis in half, just clips the flap as he gets cramped on the shot
pitches it up, Uthappa drives hard off the front foot, edging past gully
and again, a wonderful pick-up from Kallis as Edwards veers too straight, it sat up and Kallis swatted it behind square leg for four more ... what a first over, eh?
shot! Down the pads and picked up over square leg in style
bouncer, fast too, Kallis goes for the pull but is hustled by pace and drops the ball down in front of square leg ... my Edwards is hitting it fast this evening
oh ho, full and swinging away, Uthappa goes back and keeps it out
on the pads and worked away to the on side for a single

what a ripper and Ryder's nightmare continues! He got a second-ball duck in the first game, was dropped for the second, and goes first ball on return! An express yorker from Edwards beats the bat and pegs back the off stump, fantastic start
